news.subtitle: Updates from ORBI management - payments, maintenance, and community.

article.intro: ORBI management is committed to keeping owners informed about everything that affects their property and investment. This update outlines what is changing, the timeline, and what (if any) action is required on your side.
article.whatsChangingBody: The change takes effect across all ORBI buildings. Owners do not need to re-register; existing portal credentials remain valid. Where relevant, affected apartments are flagged in the {{section}} section.
article.list1: No interruption to existing services or scheduled payments.
article.list2: All receipts and statements remain available for download in Reports.
article.list3: Support is available 24/7 for any questions related to this notice.
article.whatToDoBody: Review the attached document, and if you have an outstanding balance, you can settle it directly from your apartment's billing page. For anything unclear, contact the management office or open a support ticket from the portal.
